resolutions.note: Took the per-item-claim branch. `partial` is a separate list from `unmonitored` and the coverage card states one sentence per group. The pre-existing test was arranged so it could not see the bug (NOENTRY at price 10.0 vs ma 9.0, above the MA); moved to 8.0/9.0 so it breaks its MA. details carries both unmonitored and partially_monitored.

Took tolerate-holes, not report-accurately: reporting alone leaves a ticker with 199 real sessions unmonitored, which is the actual harm. monitor_inputs averages each column's last 50 *traded* closes. Reason string also corrected to 'fewer than 50 traded sessions', so both halves of the acceptance hold. Both realistic inputs verified: yf.py:_shape_panel:30 keeps rows on close[ref].notna() only; finmind.py:_price_frames builds from per-ticker series.

Bridge only; ranking untouched (min(pool, key=score) unchanged, T39 intact). Step 3 records a one-line thesis_note per ticker; step 4 appends it to the SWAP reason when the sell side is a monitored setup, plus details['incumbent_setup_type'] and ['incumbent_thesis'].

Took the name-the-session branch. monitor_inputs returns the panel's last index label; propose(asof=) threads it; one _price_phrase helper serves both card sites. details['asof'] on every thesis card. Deliberately did NOT drop today's bar in the provider — that discards a legitimately closed session after the US/TW close.
